screenLevelIssues.explanation: The current implementation in the simulator (a simple list row) completely fails to match the Figma design, which specifies a rich 'Credit Card / selected' component. The design requires a 270x400px card with a dark textured background (#202020), Visa logo, 'SELECTED' badge, and specific typography hierarchy. The simulator merely shows text in a list format.

  <Text>Credit Card .... 2341</Text>
</View>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The card number '•••• 2341' in Figma uses the brand orange color (#FF9A6D) and a larger font size (20px). The simulator renders this text in white and a smaller standard font size.

The Figma design uses a complex background stack: a solid #202020 fill, an image overlay (opacity 0.16), and a solid black overlay (opacity 0.64). The simulator appears to use a plain solid background.

feedback.explanation: The current implementation is a simple list row. It must be replaced with a detailed Credit Card component (270x400px) containing specific nested elements (Visa logo, Chip, Number, Expiry, CVV) to match Figma Node 243:3794.
feedback.fixedCode:
<View style={styles.cardContainer}>
  {/* Background Vectors */}
  <View style={styles.bgPattern1} />
  <View style={styles.bgPattern2} />
  
  {/* Header Section */}
  <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
    <Text style={styles.headerText}>CREDIT CARD</Text>
    <View style={styles.headerIcon} />
  </View>

  {/* Card Details */}
  <View style={styles.cardContent}>
    <View style={styles.visaLogo} />
    <View style={styles.chipContainer} />
    <Text style={styles.cardNumber}>•••• 2341</Text>
    <View style={styles.detailsContainer}>
      <Text style={styles.expiryText}>EXPIRY 06/26</Text>
      <Text style={styles.cvvText}>CVV •••</Text>
    </View>
  </View>
</View>
